Menu.Main.MessageOfTheDay.en-US: Welcome to..whatever this is I have no idea why this even exists. You presumably know what you're doing and don't need me to tell you what's up. Not that I could anyway, since this is your build, not mine. It's updatable anyway, but not really for any good reason. If you have any feedback or find any bugs, make sure they aren't yours before letting us know on GitHub or Discord. Happy YARGin'!

Welcome to v0.16 nightly! Note: As of b4115 the settings menu UI has been overhauled and menus have been reorganized. Practice mode is now in Game Modes alongside the experimental Career Mode. You can create your own custom careers by copying one of the existing careers in the presets tab in Settings. The UI is very much a work in progress, so feel free to suggest any changes you think should be made, and if you're an artist who can help make it look better, please reach out on Discord. ICYMI, we also have support for 6 fret now, so if you have a 6 fret guitar, please test it out and provide feedback! Other recently added features include: - ASIO/WASAPI Exclusive support for lower latency audio - Custom profile avatars (png only for now) If you have any feedback or find any bugs, please let us know on Discord or GitHub. Happy YARGin'!

Welcome to v0.15! v0.15 is a major update that adds many highly requested and necessary gameplay features such as roll/trill lanes and Big "YARG" endings, as well as revamped user interface in the song selection and results screen, drum lane customization, automatic genre categorization, experimental custom vocalist characters in venues, and more. If you have any feedback or find any bugs, please let us know on Discord or GitHub. Happy YARGin'!
